content.json:
## PolySwarm status

This page reads only tables in your own workspace. It never calls PolySwarm and needs no credential. A tile that says nothing has arrived yet is normal on a new install: each one fills as its source starts producing data.

content.query:
union isfuzzy=true ThreatIntelIndicators, (datatable(TimeGenerated:datetime, SourceSystem:string, LastUpdateMethod:string)[])
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where SourceSystem == 'PolySwarm' and LastUpdateMethod == 'PolySwarm hunting'
| summarize Indicators = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
| order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: Hunting connector: indicators per hour
content.noDataMessage: No hunt results yet. This fills when one of your PolySwarm hunts matches a file. That is normal for a new connection.

content.query:
union isfuzzy=true ThreatIntelIndicators, (datatable(TimeGenerated:datetime, SourceSystem:string, LastUpdateMethod:string)[])
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where SourceSystem == 'PolySwarm' and LastUpdateMethod == 'PolySwarm curated feed'
| summarize Indicators = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
| order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: Curated feed connector: indicators per hour
content.noDataMessage: No feed indicators yet. This fills after the first poll, within an hour of connecting.

content.query:
union isfuzzy=true ThreatIntelIndicators, (datatable(TimeGenerated:datetime, SourceSystem:string, LastUpdateMethod:string)[])
| where SourceSystem == 'PolySwarm'
| extend Connector = case(LastUpdateMethod == 'PolySwarm hunting', 'Hunting connector', LastUpdateMethod == 'PolySwarm curated feed', 'Curated feed connector', 'Other')
| summarize ['Last row received'] = max(TimeGenerated), ['Rows in workspace'] = count() by Connector
content.title: Last indicator received, by connector
content.noDataMessage: No rows received from either connector yet. This is normal before a connector is configured and its first poll has run.

content.query:
union isfuzzy=true SentinelHealth, (datatable(TimeGenerated:datetime, SentinelResourceType:string, SentinelResourceName:string, Status:string, Description:string)[])
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where SentinelResourceType == 'Data connector' and SentinelResourceName has 'PolySwarm'
| project TimeGenerated, Connector = SentinelResourceName, Status, Description
| order by TimeGenerated desc
content.title: Connector health records
content.noDataMessage: No health records for the PolySwarm connectors yet. Records appear after health monitoring is turned on for the workspace and a connector has run.

content.title: Sandbox detonations by verdict
content.noDataMessage: No detonations yet. This fills after a PolySwarm sandbox playbook completes its first detonation.

content.query:
union isfuzzy=true SecurityAlert, (datatable(TimeGenerated:datetime, AlertName:string, AlertSeverity:string, Status:string)[])
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where AlertName in~ ('PolySwarm high-confidence hunt hit', 'PolySwarm malicious file observed', 'PolySwarm sandbox detonation malicious')
| summarize Alerts = count(), ['Last alert'] = max(TimeGenerated) by AlertName, AlertSeverity
content.title: Alerts from the PolySwarm analytics rules
content.noDataMessage: No alerts from the PolySwarm rules yet. The rules ship switched off; this fills after you turn one on and it matches.
